newsitem.title: KENYA: Rwanda genocide tribunal employee murdered.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda genocide tribunal employee murdered.

text.p: The U.N. tribunal on Rwanda's genocide said on Wednesday an employee at its headquarters was killed in an attack at her home but stressed it was unrelated to the tribunal's work.
Elizabeth Assey, 48, a Tanzanian employee in the general services department was attacked at her home in the northern Tanzanian town of Arusha on Monday, said tribunal spokesman Alessandro Caldarone.
"A criminal attack took place at her residence. She was killed with two machete cuts and brought to hospital where she died," said Caldarone, adding police were investigating.
"It is not an attack against the tribunal," he said.
A Rwandan witness due to testify at the tribunal was killed in Rwanda last December in an apparent attempt to intimidate other potential witnesses.
The tribunal has suspended its first trial of a former Hutu mayor accused of genocide and crimes against humanity until March 6.

The United Nations was expected to announce in New York on Wednesday measures it would take in response to an internal report that criticised the tribunal for corruption, mismanagement and waste, Caldarone said.
